purpose: Small deterministic integration and resource-regression controls; not human-decontamination accuracy validation
pair_policy: Remove the whole pair if either mate aligns; retain only both-unmapped primary pairs
native_oracle: Direct Bowtie2 SAM output filtered with samtools fastq primary/both-unmapped flags on unique-ID controls; compare decoded records, IDs and qualities, not compressed bytes
resource_budget: candidate median monotonic elapsed <= max(2 * native median, native median + 1 second)
resource_units: elapsed/CPU seconds; GNU time maximum RSS in KiB; retain all conflicting timers
excluded_cost: Index construction is recorded separately from filtering measurements
native_pipeline_smoke: 1000 previously hash-verified ENA read pairs plus 100 synthetic reference-matching pairs; existing cached Standard-8 database; inspect accounting and component agreement
interpretation_limits: Generated references/reads are not biological replicates or held-out human reads
Known shared sequence can be removed from a microbial-labelled control
No host-absence, privacy, clinical, sensitivity/specificity or speedup claim
No multi-GB host reference download is included
